title: Electrocatalytic aldehyde oxidation: an emerging anodic reaction for efficient electrolytic systems
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,904-920
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01515K, Review Article
Fen Hu, Pengyuan Wang, Zhiwen Lu, Kai Chen, Yichun Ding, Li Wang, Zhenhai Wen
Electrocatalytic aldehyde oxidation, which has low oxidation potentials, has emerged as a promising anodic reaction to be coupled with a diversity of electroreduction reactions.
